purpose: Defines forge-specific policies for authoring Claude Code SKILLs and agents, on top of the generic authoring guide: verifying official specs, inheritance-type SKILLs, custom Agents, and user questions.
summary: How to verify official Claude Code specifications
SKILLs are inheritance-type; no context: fork or agent
Isolated-context work goes to custom Agents
Inheritance SKILL must state it does only its own task
New custom Agent needs design rationale and Role constraint tests
Exception for discussion-centered SKILLs with declared boundary
Do not block AskUserQuestion via disallowed-tools
SKILL.md descriptions are written in Japanese
